hook: Three async streams tame Apple's oldest-feeling Bluetooth API.

beats.say: CoreBluetooth is one of the oldest-feeling APIs an iOS developer still uses, with everything arriving through delegate callbacks.
The author built Pulse, a small SwiftUI app that reads live heart rate from any chest strap or watch using the standard Bluetooth Heart Rate service.
He put a Swift Concurrency API in front of it, with three async streams for availability, scanning, and connecting, so the rest of the app never sees a delegate.
beats.statLabel: async streams in the new API
